targetText: A number of writers, would-be Marxists, have this year undertaken a veritable campaign against the philosophy of Marxism.
explanation: Lenin identifies the rise of philosophical revisionism inside the revolutionary movement, where prominent Social-Democrats sought to smuggle subjective idealist doctrines into Marxist theory under the guise of intellectual progress.

targetText: Marx and Engels scores of times termed their philosophical views dialectical materialism.
explanation: Lenin emphasizes that dialectical materialism is the unified, foundational world-outlook of scientific socialism, which cannot be dismembered or combined with rival bourgeois philosophies without destroying its revolutionary essence.
